commits_data.message:
Restrict Wi-SUN Vendor ID to 2 bytes

From Wi-SUN FAN 1.1v08 sections 6.3.2.3.1.6 and 6.3.2.3.2.3:

    This field MUST NOT exceed 2 octets in length, providing for Vendor
    Identifiers no larger than ((2^14) -1).
